en.baptism: In the year one thousand eight hundred and ninety-seven, on the third day of January, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, Fr. Baltruken baptised a child named Antanas with all the rites of the Sacrament.
en.parents: Illegitimate son of the peasant woman Anna, daughter of P[illegible]kopav, Zaborska, of Plungė district, born on the 3rd of January 1897 in the village of Šilai of the Plungė parish.
en.godparents: The godparents were Antanas Kašinskis and Petronela, his wife.
en.side:
Zaborskoi
born 3, baptised 3
Later note: Antanas Zaborskis received the sacrament of marriage in Telšiai church on 11 November 1931, marrying Rozalija Savickaitė.

en.godparents: The godparents were Ignas Čudas and Petronela Gudasovna, a maiden.

issues.en: Birth year written 1817 in the draft (likely an error for 1897); kept as drafted.
issues.lt: Gimimo metai juodraštyje 1817 (greičiausiai klaida vietoj 1897); palikta kaip juodraštyje.
